metadata.description: SFP, Skills for Productivity: skills from many repos in one place, sorted by what you build, for Claude Code and every other agent IDE.

plugins.name: sfp
plugins.description: The router: one skill that knows every category and every skill, and sends the agent to the right one.

plugins.name: frontend
plugins.description: UI design, components, motion, accessibility and frontend frameworks (React, Vue, Next.js, Angular, Vite).

plugins.name: design-styles
plugins.description: 67 named visual styles (brutalism, glassmorphism, editorial, retro, shadcn and more) to build in.

plugins.name: backend
plugins.description: Backend frameworks, APIs and databases (Django, FastAPI, Spring Boot, Laravel, NestJS, Rails, Postgres, Redis, Prisma).

plugins.name: mobile
plugins.description: Android, iOS, Flutter, React Native, Kotlin Multiplatform and Swift.

plugins.name: languages
plugins.description: Language idioms, standards and testing for Go, Rust, Python, C++, C#, F#, Java, Kotlin, Perl and .NET.

plugins.name: testing-quality
plugins.description: TDD, end-to-end tests, verification loops, code review, regression and quality gates.

plugins.name: devops
plugins.description: Docker, Kubernetes, deployment, canary watching, git and GitHub workflows, terminals and environments.

plugins.name: security
plugins.description: Strix autonomous pentesting, OWASP testing, secure coding for each framework, and agent security hardening.

plugins.name: agents
plugins.description: Agent-driven work: autonomous loops, orchestration, councils, dev teams, planning and feature pipelines.

plugins.name: agent-dev
plugins.description: Building for agents: skills, plugins, hooks, MCP servers, harness setup, memory, context and token budgets.

plugins.name: ai-ml
plugins.description: LLM pipelines, prompts, evals, RAG, PyTorch, ML engineering, recommender systems and AI media.

plugins.name: ai-gateway
plugins.description: Driving an OmniRoute AI gateway: routing, providers, budgets, caching, compression, MCP and A2A.

plugins.name: data-apis
plugins.description: Direct access to data: a searchable list of about 2,100 free public APIs, internet reach across 16 platforms, search and scraping.

plugins.name: content-media
plugins.description: Writing, marketing, SEO, video, slides, social posting and brand voice.

plugins.name: business-ops
plugins.description: Billing, finance, investors, market research, sales leads, contracts, email, calendars, tickets and project flow.

plugins.name: industry
plugins.description: Domain playbooks: healthcare (HIPAA, EMR, CDSS), logistics, customs, inventory, production and energy.

plugins.name: networking
plugins.description: Network engineering and homelab: Cisco IOS, BGP, VLANs, WireGuard, Pi-hole, config validation.

plugins.name: research-docs
plugins.description: Deep research, scientific databases, literature review, documentation, ADRs and codebase onboarding.

plugins.name: web3
plugins.description: DeFi, EVM, prediction markets, Itô baskets and compute, and trading-agent security.

plugins.name: engineering
plugins.description: General engineering practice: architecture, standards, error handling, performance, benchmarks and refactoring.

plugins.name: science-hardware
plugins.description: Math proof and olympiad work, Blender, and M5Stack and Cardputer hardware.

plugins.name: memory
plugins.description: claude-mem's skills: search past work, build timelines, hand off sessions, plan and run work with persistent memory. Many need claude-mem installed.

plugins.name: career
plugins.description: AI job search: evaluate offers, tailor CVs, scan job portals and track applications. Runs from its own checkout.

plugins.name: session-memory
plugins.description: Persistent memory across Claude Code sessions (claude-mem), with search, timelines and handoffs. Claude Code only: it needs claude-mem's hooks and worker.

plugins.name: ecc-full
plugins.description: The complete Everything Claude Code plugin: its hooks, agents and commands on top of its skills. Overlaps the ECC skills spread across the category plugins, so install one or the other.

plugins.name: omniroute-full
plugins.description: The complete OmniRoute plugin. Overlaps the ai-gateway category, so install one or the other.

plugins.name: sai
plugins.description: Sai, a personal voice assistant (OpenRouter brain, Jev judgment, open-interpreter hands, Fish Audio voice). Private repo: installs only for accounts with access.
